```{python}
#| include: false
import _helpers as h
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
dmps = h.load_dmps()
erbs = h.load_erbs()
kpi = h.kpi_table(dmps)
rev = h.revision_summary(dmps)
k_total = kpi["Total DMPs"]
k_approval = f'{kpi["Approval rate"]:.0%}'
k_erb = f'{kpi["ERB linkage rate"]:.0%}'
k_repo = f'{kpi["Trusted repository rate"]:.0%}'
k_raps = f'{kpi["RAPS archival rate"]:.0%}'
k_revision = f'{rev["% with ≥1 revision"]:.0%}'
```

::: {layout="[1,1,1,1,1,1]"}

`{python} k_total`
:::

:::
::: {.callout-caution title="ERB linkage"}
`{python} k_erb`
:::
::: {.callout-warning title="Trusted repository"}
`{python} k_repo`
:::
::: {.callout-important title="Archived at RAPS"}

:::

## Compliance {.tabset}

### Approval by department

> **Q1.** What share of research projects have an **approved Data Management Plan (DMP)**, broken down **per department**?

```{python}
df = h.approval_by_department(dmps)
fig = px.bar(
    df,
    x="Approval rate",
    y="Department",
    orientation="h",
    text=df["Approval rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0%}"),
    hover_data=["DMPs", "Approved"],
    color="Approval rate",
    color_continuous_scale="Blues",
)
fig.update_layout(
    yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
    xaxis_tickformat="0%",
    coloraxis_showscale=False,
    height=500,
)
fig
```

### ERB approval by department

> **Q2.** What share of projects require **Ethical Review Board (ERB) approval** — i.e., what share of research involving **human data** has valid ethical approval and an integrated DMP?

```{python}
df = h.erb_approval_by_department(dmps, erbs)
fig = px.bar(
    df,
    x="Approval rate",
    y="Department",
    orientation="h",
    text=df["Approval rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0%}"),
    hover_data=["ERBs", "Approved"],
    color="Approval rate",
    color_continuous_scale="Greens",
)
fig.update_layout(
    yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
    xaxis_tickformat="0%",
    coloraxis_showscale=False,
    height=500,
)
fig
```

### ERB decisions

> **Q2.** What share of projects require **Ethical Review Board (ERB) approval** — i.e., what share of research involving **human data** has valid ethical approval and an integrated DMP?

```{python}
df = h.erb_breakdown(dmps, erbs)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Decision", y="ERBs", color="Decision", text="ERBs")
fig.update_layout(showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```

### Repository choice

> **Q5.** To what extent do projects **publish their FAIR data in a trusted repository** — i.e., what share of researchers selected a repository for publication (open or restricted)?

```{python}
df = h.repository_breakdown(dmps)
df = df[df["Repository"] != "(none)"]
fig = px.bar(df, x="DMPs", y="Repository", orientation="h", text="DMPs", color="Repository")
fig.update_layout(yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"}, showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```

### Archive location

> **Q6.** What share of projects **archive their data at the TU/e archive (RAPS)**?

```{python}
df = h.archive_breakdown(dmps)
fig = px.pie(df, names="Location", values="DMPs", hole=0.4)
fig.update_layout(height=500)
fig
```

## Data handling {.tabset}

### Storage

> **Q3.** To what extent do projects use **TU/e secured storage**, and conversely, what share of **sensitive research data** is stored **outside** TU/e-supported solutions?

```{python}
df = h.storage_split(dmps)
fig = px.pie(df, names="Category", values="DMPs", hole=0.4)
fig.update_layout(height=500)
fig
```

### Storage solution count

> **Q3.** To what extent do projects use **TU/e secured storage**, and conversely, what share of **sensitive research data** is stored **outside** TU/e-supported solutions?

```{python}
df = h.storage_count_distribution(dmps)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Solutions", y="DMPs", text="DMPs", color="DMPs")

fig
```

> **Q3.** To what extent do projects use **TU/e secured storage**, and conversely, what share of **sensitive research data** is stored **outside** TU/e-supported solutions?

```{python}
df = h.sensitive_data_outside_tue(dmps)
```

### Data sharing

> **Q4.** What share of projects require a **data sharing/receiving agreement** or other legal agreement (DPIA, etc., for special-category data)? How many DMPs **triggered a DA (Data Agreement) request**?

```{python}

fig
```

## Workflow {.tabset}

### Revisions

> **Q7.** How often does a DMP enter the **"Revision Requested"** status?

```{python}
df = h.revision_distribution(dmps)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Revisions", y="DMPs", text="DMPs", color="DMPs")
fig.update_layout(showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```

### Days to first submission

> **Q8.** How long elapses between **DRAFT and SUBMITTED** (ideally pre-computed as `days_to_first_submission`)?

```{python}
s = h.days_to_first_submission(dmps).dropna()
fig = px.histogram(s, nbins=40, labels={"value": "Days"})
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Days",
    yaxis_title="DMPs",
    height=500,
    showlegend=False,
    annotations=[dict(
        text=f"Median: {s.median():.0f} days | Mean: {s.mean():.1f} days",
        xref="paper", x=0.98, yref="paper", y=0.98, xanchor="right", showarrow=False,
    )],
)
fig
```

### First response time

> **Q9.** How long does it take a **Data Steward to first respond** after submission (ideally pre-computed)?

```{python}
s = h.first_response_time(dmps).dropna()
fig = px.histogram(s, nbins=40, labels={"value": "Days"})
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Days",
    yaxis_title="DMPs",
    height=500,
    showlegend=False,
    annotations=[dict(
        text=f"Median: {s.median():.0f} days | Mean: {s.mean():.1f} days",
        xref="paper", x=0.98, yref="paper", y=0.98, xanchor="right", showarrow=False,
    )],
)
fig
```

### Help needed

> **Q10.** What proportion of DMPs state **"I need help"** during first submission?

```{python}
df = h.help_needed_rate(dmps)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Field", y="Rate", text=df["Rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.1%}"), color="Field")
fig.update_layout(yaxis_tickformat="0%", showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```
